title: Browser Autonomy Benchmark Suite
description: Thirty-three underspecified single-HTML browser tasks, each exposed as a controlled A/B/C prompt ladder for measuring model autonomy, execution quality, coherence, and polish.

A.name: Raw
A.purpose: Minimum specification. Measures natural interpretation and unsolicited quality decisions.

B.name: Autonomous
B.purpose: Same task with explicit permission to make design and implementation decisions.

C.name: Production-quality
C.purpose: Same task with a finished-experience quality target while leaving implementation choices open.

benchmarks.title: Rollercoaster

prompts.A: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js.
prompts.B: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js. Make sensible design and implementation decisions yourself.
prompts.C: Create a first-person rollercoaster with continuous playback in a single HTML file using Three.js. It should feel like a finished, polished interactive experience rather than a technical prototype. Decide all other design and implementation details yourself.

benchmarks.notes: Do not add hidden implementation requirements beyond the prompt. Evaluate what the model chooses to contribute.
